hook_text: As the Sun sets in Durban, the city switches itself on. Who flips all the switches?
clip_script: Dusk in Durban. Street lights flicker on: a light sensor closes the circuit. The robot goes red: a timer controls the lights. A car hoots, a signal reaches the control box, and a motor slides the gate open. The shop locks up, and the alarm waits for a door switch to set off the siren. In the café, a motor spins the fan. Every one: a circuit solving a problem!
visual_style: Whiteboard street scene at dusk with each system labelled input, process, output as it switches on.
mood: Warm city evening, buzzing with clever machines.
pacing: One system every few seconds as the sky darkens.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find five circuit systems on your street.
